definite_static_findings.fact: Response predicate is installed before click and matches exact origin/path plus POST. It waits on any matching status,then asserts200. Request is local-only and checks CSRF before fetch. Every fetch gets an AbortController with15,000ms timer; aborted/network failures map to ControlError status0/RESPONSE_UNKNOWN. Native response waiter default30s can time out after UI has already aborted its request.
